english: Mapandan sits in the Third Congressional District of Pangasinan, bounded by San Jacinto to the north, Mangaldan to the northwest, Manaoag to the east, and Santa Barbara to the south. Covering 32.92 square kilometres, around three-quarters of its land supports agriculture — mainly rice, alongside corn, livestock, and seasonal vegetables. The municipal administration operates under the tagline “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato” (Partnering with you in Active and Responsible Leadership).
filipino: Matatagpuan ang Mapandan sa Ikatlong Kongresyonal na Distrito ng Pangasinan, na nasa hangganan ng San Jacinto sa hilaga, Mangaldan sa hilagang-kanluran, Manaoag sa silangan, at Santa Barbara sa timog. May lawak itong 32.92 kilometro kuwadrado, at halos tatlong-kapat ng lupain nito ay ginagamit sa agrikultura—pangunahing palay, kasama ang mais, paghahayupan, at mga pana-panahong gulay. Isinasagawa ng pamahalaang bayan ang mga programa nito sa ilalim ng tagline na “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato.”
pangasinan: Nakatugaw so Mapandan ed Ikatlong Kongresonal a Distrito na Pangasinan, napaliber ed San Jacinto ed norte, Mangaldan ed hilagang-kanluran, Manaoag ed east, tan Santa Barbara ed south. Say lawak to et 32.92 square kilometers, tan antapud 3/4 na daga et para ed agrikultura—pangunahing palay, kaiba so mais, alaga a animales, tan pana-panahon a gulay. Mantrabaho so administrasyon na baley ed silong na tagline a “Kaakibat niyo ang Aktibo at Responsableng Liderato.”

english: A severe epidemic forced temporary re-annexation to Mangaldan due to financial insolvency. Full autonomy was restored in 1909 under Executive Order No. 10 by Governor General James F. Smith.
filipino: Isang matinding epidemya ang nagbunsod sa pansamantalang muling pagsasanib sa Mangaldan dahil sa kawalang-kakayahang pinansiyal. Naibalik ang buong awtonomiya noong 1909 sa ilalim ng Executive Order Blg. 10 ni Gobernador-Heneral James F. Smith.

english: The Municipality of Mapandan operates under Republic Act No. 7160 (Local Government Code of 1991), situated within the Third Congressional District of Pangasinan. The Sangguniang Bayan — a unicameral local legislative council — exercises municipal legislative power, presided by the Municipal Vice Mayor and composed of elected councilors alongside ex-officio representatives from the Liga ng mga Barangay and the Sangguniang Kabataan Federation.

Say Sangguniang Bayan—sakey a unicameral local legislative council—so mangipatupad na municipal legislative power. Pangulo to so Municipal Vice Mayor tan kaiba iray elected councilors tan ex-officio representatives na Liga ng mga Barangay tan Sangguniang Kabataan Federation.
